{"choices": [{"finish_reason": "tool_calls", "index": 0, "message": {"content": "`git fetch --all --tags` fetches the tag objects and their commits, so `git checkout 1 fastlane/Fastfile` works. Good, the pre-existing behavior for non-caching with version works.

Now, my fix preserves this behavior. Let me verify the non-caching with version case works in my reproduction test (Test 3 already passed). 

Now let me also consider: in the non-caching case with version, after `git fetch --all --tags`, `current_tag` (from `git describe --exact-match --tags HEAD`) would still be the latest tag (e.g., "3"), not the requested version "1". So `current_tag != version`, and checkout happens. Good.

But what if the requested version IS the latest tag? E.g., `version: '3'` and HEAD is at tag "3". Then `current_tag == version == "3"`. With my condition `unless is_eligible_for_caching && !version.nil? && current_tag == version`:
- `is_eligible_for_caching` is false â condition is false â checkout HAPPENS â

Good, because in the non-caching case the clone is `--no-checkout`, so even if HEAD is at the right tag, the files aren't checked out yet. We MUST checkout. My fix handles this correctly because `is_eligible_for_caching` is false.
